text:
Sophia: Quick check — following INC-901 postmortem, can we lock owners + due dates for the remaining action items? I added a draft table in the RCA doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-901. Need cross-team confirms by EOD Friday.

Maria: Looking now. I can take the 'redis patch + backfill' but I need infra help to schedule the migration window. Tentative due 2025-04-15.

Jay: I can own the migration window coordination, but I need an SRE runbook verification beforehand. ETA for me: 2025-04-18 for migration. I'll also pick up the 'canary rollback playbook' item.

Oliver: I own 'alert threshold tuning' and 'dashboards update' — I can finish by 2025-04-14 and will open the PR: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/42

Maria: For backfill I need a data access ticket (service account + read-only role). @Helena can you create that?

ops-bot: Reminder: INC-901 RCA doc updated by Sophia at 1745557700. Enterprise SLA flag set; vendor outreach required if rollout slips.

Helena: Created ticket DIT-789 for the service account (access scope: backfill-only). ETA 2025-04-12.

Sophia: Updated the table — please confirm by replying 'ack' and note any conflicts. Current snapshot pasted below: 

```
Action: redis patch + backfill
Owner: Maria
Deps: migration window (infra), data access (DIT-789)
Due: 2025-04-15

Action: migration window + verification run
Owner: Jay
Deps: SRE runbook review, canary plan
Due: 2025-04-18

Action: alert threshold tuning
Owner: Oliver
Deps: post-migration metrics
Due: 2025-04-14

Action: dashboards update (customer-facing)
Owner: Oliver
Deps: alert tuning, PR review
Due: 2025-04-14

Action: canary rollback playbook
Owner: Jay
Deps: runbook, oncall signoff
Due: 2025-04-16
```

Jay: ack — I'll coordinate runbook review with eng-sre channel now and post an ETA update there.

Maria: ack. One blocker note: backfill won't start until migration completes. If migration slips we may need to push backfill by >=3 days.

Oliver: ack, will sequence dashboards update after migration completes.

Sophia: Thanks all. Final ask — owners, please update the RCA doc table with any micro-changes + link PRs by EOD today. If a due date will slip >3 days, ping me directly and mark the RCA row with the reason. :thumbsup:

Helena: ack, updated DIT ticket with the service account info and included a pointer to the RCA doc.

ops-bot: NOTE: SLA follow-up required if any action slips beyond due date threshold.

Sophia: If anyone needs help escalating to product/security for the enterprise followup, @me and I'll route. Otherwise, I'll run a short check-in on Monday morning to verify statuses. :eyes:
